english_draft: Source: NVIDIA official press release, dated August 26, 2026. This release reports the second quarter of fiscal 2027. The quarter ended July 26, 2026. Revenue was $96.2 billion. Revenue increased 18% from the prior quarter and 106% from a year ago. Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion. Data Center revenue increased 18% from the prior quarter and 117% from a year ago. Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion. Edge Computing revenue increased 13% from the prior quarter and 27% from a year ago. GAAP gross margin was 75.0%. Non-GAAP gross margin was 75.0%. GAAP diluted EPS was $2.46. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $2.22. GAAP net income was $59.688 billion. Non-GAAP net income was $53.954 billion. Non-GAAP net income was lower than GAAP net income. The company excluded net gains from equity securities of $7.771 billion from non-GAAP. The company returned $26.0 billion to shareholders. The company had $99.0 billion remaining under share repurchase authorization. The next dividend is $0.25 per share. There is no same-period Preview in the collected sources. There is no company guidance from before this report in the source. Therefore, this analysis cannot compare results with a pre-existing Preview. The company gave outlook for the third quarter of fiscal 2027. Revenue outlook is $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. The outlook assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China. GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin outlook is 74.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points. The next quarter focus is revenue, gross margin, and China.
reader_questions: 数据中心收入 890 亿美元与边缘计算收入 72 亿美元相加恰为总收入 962 亿美元，但来源未提供完整分部表，是否还有其他业务被归入这两项？
Non-GAAP 净利润低于 GAAP 净利润，这与多数公司相反；是否因为当期权益证券净收益 77.71 亿美元属于非经常项目，剔除后才能反映可持续盈利能力？
下一季指引“不假设任何中国数据中心计算收入”，是否意味着公司已经失去中国数据中心业务，还是仅为指引的保守假设？来源未给出中国收入占比，无法判断影响幅度。
fact_checks: 第一轮核实：来源标题为 Second Quarter Fiscal 2027，发布日期 2026-08-26，季度截止 2026-07-26；任务编号 2026Q3 指发布季而非财报季度，已在正文口径说明。收入、净利润、EPS、毛利率均核对来源表格，单位为百万美元；GAAP 与非 GAAP 已区分。Data Center 890 亿与 Edge Computing 72 亿相加等于总收入 962 亿，来源未列其他分部。Non-GAAP 净利润低于 GAAP 的原因由 Non-GAAP 定义（剔除 equity securities 净损益）及现金流量表 77.71 亿美元净收益推断，正文已标明为推断。公司指引、股东回报、股息、中国假设均逐字核对。来源未含财报前 Preview、公司前期指引或市场一致预期，因此正文写明无同期 Preview，且不计算预期差。第二轮互检：以初次读者身份提出三条问题后，正文补充了分部口径存疑、Non-GAAP 低于 GAAP 的推断属性、中国收入为指引假设而非已披露实际数；确认结论与证据一致：收入环比加速、数据中心是主驱动、下一季中国收入缺失是最大不确定项。
